title: tc-plan-vs-actual
description: An agent's plan against what really happens, as a live Gantt chart. Clean look only.

steps.description: The plan's steps, in order – each with its planned time, what it waits for, and its real start and end so far

now.description: The clock, in epoch ms – without it (and without `elapsed`) the chart reads the clock after it connects and ticks while the run goes on

startedAt.description: When the run started, in epoch ms – defaults to the earliest step start

elapsed.description: Where the run is now as ms from its start; step start/end are then run-relative too. Takes precedence over `now`

task.description: What the run is for – e.g. "Ship the pricing page"

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

title.description: What the step does, in a few words – e.g. "Build the layout"

plan.description: How long it was planned to take, in ms

deps.description: Steps that have to finish first

start.description: When it really started – epoch ms, on the same clock as `now` (or ms from the start of the run with `elapsed`). Leave out while it waits

end.description: When it really finished – leave out while it runs

cost.description: What it has cost so far – shown when you point at the step, and added up in the bar on top

planCost.description: What it was planned to cost – the plan's total shows next to the spend
